competences.description: Smites the enemy, removing 1 beneficial effect and decreasing its Attack Speed and Attack Power for 3 turns. In addition, deals additional damage by the shield amount of the boss.
Strikes all enemies, decreasing their Defense for 3 turns.
Whenever attacked, deals damage to the attacker with burning flames, recovers HP in proportion to the damage dealt, and creates a shield equal to the recovery amount. [Automatic Effect]
